class.name: OrthoplexPolyMeshND
class.brief_description: A ND polyhedral mesh representing an orthoplex (cross-polytope).
class.description: OrthoplexPolyMeshND is a class for generating polyhedral meshes representing orthoplexes, also known as ND cross-polytopes. An N-dimensional orthoplex is composed of 2N vertices, plus and minus on each axis, and 2^N simplex boundary cells, one in each orthant. The full polyhedral hierarchy is generated procedurally for the mesh's dimension, including a volumetric hypervolume cell, boundary cells oriented to point outward, and flat shading vertex normals. The 4D version of an orthoplex is the 16-cell or hexadecachoron, which has 8 vertices and 16 tetrahedral cells. The 3D version is the octahedron, which has 6 vertices and 8 triangular faces. The 2D version is a diamond (square rotated 45 degrees), which has 4 vertices and 4 edges. Orthoplexes exist in all dimensions, and are the dual of boxes (square/cube/hypercube). The orthoplex has a built-in texture map, generated procedurally for the orthoplex's dimension. The vertex of the positive last axis maps to the center of the texture space, the vertices of the other axes map to points offset by half a unit from the center on the corresponding texture axis, and the negative last axis vertex of each cell maps to the center reflected over the hyperplane through the cell's other texture points, giving it many disconnected texture representations. For other layouts, convert the orthoplex with [method PolyMeshND.to_array_poly_mesh] and use [method ArrayPolyMeshND.unwrap_texture_map].

method.name: from_orthoplex_cell_mesh
method.description: Creates an orthoplex polyhedral mesh from [OrthoplexCellMeshND]. The orthoplex polyhedral mesh will have the same size and material as the cellhedral mesh.

method.name: from_orthoplex_wire_mesh
method.description: Creates an orthoplex polyhedral mesh from [OrthoplexWireMeshND]. The orthoplex polyhedral mesh will have the same size and material as the wireframe mesh.

method.name: to_orthoplex_cell_mesh
method.description: Converts this orthoplex polyhedral mesh to a [OrthoplexCellMeshND]. The cellhedral mesh will have the same size and material as the polyhedral mesh.

method.name: to_orthoplex_wire_mesh
method.description: Converts this orthoplex polyhedral mesh to a [OrthoplexWireMeshND]. The wireframe mesh will have the same size and material as the polyhedral mesh.

members.member: The dimension of the orthoplex mesh, which is the amount of numbers in the [member size] array. Setting this grows or shrinks the [member size] array to the given amount of dimensions. Orthoplexes with more than 10 dimensions are not supported, because the amount of generated cells grows exponentially with the dimension.

The half-extents of the orthoplex in meters, also known as just "extents". This is the "radius" of the orthoplex, the distance between each vertex and the center. This is a wrapper around [member size] for situations where you want to use the extents instead of size.

The size of the orthoplex in meters. This is the axis-aligned "diameter" size of the orthoplex in ND space, where each component is the distance between opposite vertices. This is the value that is stored internally.
